summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in animate-twcss-pack 2.0.6
details: animate-twcss-pack 2.0.6 contains no observed exfiltration, install-time or import-time code execution, silent-relay, credential distribution, backdoor, or self-propagation behavior. No lifecycle scripts fetching or executing remote content were identified, and no reads of installer-side secrets (environment variables, ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser or wallet stores) were identified. The package appears to be a small utility distribution with no code paths that harm the party installing it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
